problem: Restaurants lose orders to missed phone calls and hold times; staff are overwhelmed.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription voice AI agent integrated with POS

founders.name: Gurveer Singh
founders.background_notes: Grew up in family restaurant, 1 to 11 locations

technical_complexity.rationale: Low-latency voice agent with POS integrations (Toast, Square, Clover); strong foundation models available by 2025.

defensibility.rationale: POS integrations create modest friction; voice-AI wrappers are widely copyable.

market_need_then: Founders cite restaurants losing up to $100k per location per year to missed calls (company claim, unverified).

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Answer every call. Take every order.

outcome_analysis: Certus AI is an S25 restaurant voice-AI company still active, so there is no outcome to explain yet. Founders have restaurant operating experience, the product integrates with major POS systems, and early claims are company-reported. No funding or competitor information was verified in this run.
